criterion: HW H2.0: the path tracer on DXR inline ray queries (hw_pt.hlsl) is equivalent to the CPU path tracer within a tolerance contract, and the contract catches planted bugs
written: 2026-11-02, before the first run of the hardware path tracer
why_a_contract: Hardware traversal is not bit-identical to ours: the driver's triangle test, its barycentrics and its order among equal t differ from raw/math/primitives.hpp, so a few paths take a different branch. Equivalence is therefore stated on per-pixel error statistics of two Monte Carlo estimates of the same image, as R2's P2 does for the compute tracer.
gpu: src/rhi/d3d12/hw_shaders/hw_pt.hlsl, generated by scripts/hw_pt_hlsl.py from pt_trace.hlsl with exactly one function replaced: trace() becomes RayQuery<RAY_FLAG_FORCE_OPAQUE> (closest) or with ACCEPT_FIRST_HIT_AND_END_SEARCH (any hit), TMin 1e-4, against one bottom-level structure of every triangle (opaque, PREFER_FAST_TRACE) in one instance

definitions.z: per pixel, z = (a - b) / sqrt(var_a + var_b) on radiance luminance, var the tracer's own variance output (sample variance of luminance over spp)
definitions.image_z: |sum a - sum b| / sqrt(sum var_a + sum var_b)

Q1_against_cpu.what: hardware against CPU at matched samples with different seeds (11 and 9001): retro_room and iso_street at 128 x 96, 256 spp, 64 bounces; raw_hall at 160 x 90, 256 spp in the full run
Q1_against_cpu.bound: P2's bound: mean |z| <= 0.9, fraction |z| > 4 <= 0.2%, image_z <= 3, no non-finite pixel

Q2_against_compute.what: hardware against the compute tracer with the same seed (11), so both draw the same random numbers and differ only where traversal differs
Q2_against_compute.bound: the Q1 bound. Reported, not bounded: fraction of pixels bit-identical, mean and max relative difference

C1_mis_weight_one.what: the hardware tracer with next-event MIS weight forced to 1 (double counting), retro_room

C2_drop_cosine.what: the hardware tracer with the Lambert cosine dropped, retro_room

C3_offset.what: the hardware instance moved by 1% of the scene box diagonal along (1, 1, 1) / sqrt 3; the CPU keeps the scene, retro_room
C3_offset.bound: Q1 must fail. Reported, not bounded: the same at 0.1%, 0.3% and 3% (the contract's resolving power)

Q3_forced_off.bound: pathTraceHw returns an error and no image; the hw-pt command reports it and takes the compute tracer

timing: reported, not bounded: GPU timestamps around every slice of the hardware and the compute tracer on the RTX 4090 at 3840 x 2160 and 64 spp on retro_room, iso_street and raw_hall; median slice time, total, and the ratio. One process, the GPU lock held, other GPU clients recorded.
adapters: D3D12 WARP (debug layer) where it offers tier 1.1; the RTX 4090 only under the D:/lw-gpu lock
does_not_prove: Equivalence on scenes not run, at other resolutions or bounce limits; any-hit or alpha-tested geometry; ray tracing pipelines (none are used); that a planted bug smaller than the reported resolving power would be caught.
